title: ThuyHuong Digital 2026 — Games: Cổng Trò Chơi Sử Việt (Vietnamese History Game Portal)
description:
ThuyHuong Digital 2026 — Games (Cổng Trò Chơi Sử Việt, Vietnamese History Game Portal) is a portal of four browser-based educational games set in documented periods of Vietnamese history. The games are written in HTML5 and JavaScript, require no installation or user account, and are published as a Progressive Web Application: once loaded, the portal installs to a device home screen, runs full screen, and remains fully playable without a network connection.

Contents of the deposit. The archive contains the complete, independently executable source of the portal and of each game, together with the application manifest, service worker, icon set, privacy policy, citation metadata and release documentation. No build step, server-side component or content delivery network is required: the repository is the deployable application.

The games.

  • Vân Đồn — The First Trading Port (1149). A construction and port management game beginning with the edict of King Lý Anh Tông that established Vân Đồn, the first international trading port of Đại Việt. The player builds piers for merchant ships from Song China, Japan, Java and Siam, opens Chu Đậu pottery kilns, silk workshops and pearl rafts, collects tax revenue, weathers storms and repels raids. The game includes tiered building upgrades, royal tribute quests, an in-game history codex, an achievements board, and a challenge mode recreating the Battle of Vân Đồn (1288), in which Trần Khánh Dư intercepted the Yuan supply fleet.
  • Bắc Hải Đảo — Pirates of the Gulf of Tonkin (1780). A maritime adventure among the limestone karsts of Hạ Long Bay. The player sails a bat-wing junk between six historic ports, trades fish sauce, silk, agarwood and pearls, engages Tàu Ô pirate vessels and survives storms. Four playable captains provide distinct starting conditions and abilities.
  • Bắc Hải Đảo 3D (1780). The same world rebuilt in three dimensions with three.js: a chase camera, animated sea surface, limestone islands, three-dimensional ports and vessels, and storm weather. Both editions are retained so that the portal continues to run on low-powered devices.
  • Chợ Nổi — Floating Market (nineteenth century). An arcade game set in the floating markets that formed along the canals of the Mekong Delta during the settlement of the southern provinces. Built on the Phaser 3 engine.

Technical characteristics. Background music is synthesised in real time with the Web Audio API on the Vietnamese pentatonic scale, emulating đàn tranh plucked strings and đàn bầu pitch bends; no audio files are shipped. Input is by keyboard on desktop and by touch on mobile devices. The two external libraries used, three.js (r147) and Phaser (3.90.0), are vendored into the repository under their own MIT licences so that each archived release is complete and independently executable.

Intended use. The portal is intended for secondary and undergraduate teaching, for self-directed learning, and for general audiences interested in Vietnamese history. Because it runs on low-specification hardware and continues to work offline after the first load, it is usable in classrooms without reliable internet access. Historical settings, place names, trade goods and events are drawn from well-documented episodes and are presented in an accompanying in-game codex; the games are nevertheless works of interactive fiction, and their mechanics, difficulty balance and narrative detail are designed for playability rather than as a scholarly source.

Privacy. The application collects no personal data. It contains no analytics, no advertising, no third-party runtime requests and no server-side component. Saved games and high scores are written to browser storage on the user's own device.

Language. The game interface and in-game historical material are in Vietnamese; documentation is provided in Vietnamese and English.

Availability. Playable at thuyhuongctu.github.io/ThuyHuong_Digital-2026-Games; source repository at github.com/thuyhuongctu/ThuyHuong_Digital-2026-Games. The games are free to play and to teach with. All rights are reserved by the author; redistribution, modification and commercial use require prior written permission.

Tiếng Việt: Cổng Trò Chơi Sử Việt gồm bốn trò chơi giáo dục lịch sử Việt Nam chạy trực tiếp trên trình duyệt — Vân Đồn (1149), Bắc Hải Đảo (1780) bản 2D và bản 3D, và Chợ Nổi (thế kỷ XIX). Cổng game cài được lên màn hình chính như một ứng dụng, chơi được khi không có mạng, không quảng cáo và không thu thập bất kỳ dữ liệu cá nhân nào. Dành cho dạy học, tự học và người quan tâm tới lịch sử Việt Nam.
